# hudu_vlan (Resource)

Manages a Hudu VLAN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hudu_vlan" "production" {
  name        = "Production"
  vlan_id     = 100
  company_id  = hudu_company.acme.id
  description = "Primary production VLAN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `company_id` (Number) ID of the owning company.
- `name` (String) VLAN name.
- `vlan_id` (Number) Numeric VLAN ID (1-4094).

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the VLAN is archived. Archived VLANs are hidden from the regular Hudu lists but remain retrievable.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the VLAN.
- `notes` (String) Additional notes about the VLAN.
- `role_list_item_id` (Number) ID of the Hudu list item representing this VLAN's role. Server-defaulted if unset.
- `status_list_item_id` (Number) ID of the Hudu list item representing this VLAN's status. Server-defaulted if unset.
- `vlan_zone_id` (Number) ID of the `hudu_vlan_zone` this VLAN belongs to. Server-defaulted if unset.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the VLAN was created, in ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. `2026-01-15T12:34:56.789Z`).
- `id` (String) Numeric ID assigned by Hudu, as a string.
- `networks_count` (Number) Number of networks associated with this VLAN.
- `slug` (String) URL slug generated by Hudu.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp the VLAN was last updated, in ISO 8601 UTC.
- `url` (String) Absolute URL of the VLAN in the Hudu web UI.
